procedural_matters: Bo Jarvig, Coach of DEN 267, attended the hearing as an observer.
Jaakko Haataja, Coach of FIN 444, attended the hearing as an observer.
Hans Cimutta, Chief Scorer, attended the hearing as an observer.
Neither party accepted a post race penalty before the hearing started.
The protest was written in Finnish language. The protestee did not understand Finnish language and was given a translation and time to prepare.
The protestors finished about 30th in the last race.
It took 15 minutes to come in from the race course Bravo.
facts: The protest was written in Fin nish language.
conclusions: Theprotest was not lodged within the protest time limit as required by SI 15.1
FIN 444 failed to deliver the protest within the protest time limit, as required byRRS 60.3(b)(1). There was no good reason for the jury to extend the time.
Theprotest did not describe the incident as required by RRS 60.3(a).
decision: The protest is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
